description: Presidential Secretariat - President has further enlarged the time by three months to submit the report of the Issuance of Treasury Bonds from 27th July, 2017 to 27th October, 2017
reasoning: This gazette notification concerns the extension of time for a Commission of Inquiry established under the Commission of Inquiry Act (a legal statute). The content focuses on the legal authority and procedure for extending the commission's reporting deadline, which falls under legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel, structure, or any other specialized category.
